apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Silent installs from winget or the vendor's signed installer.
apps.interactiveRunning: The installer window is open — finish it there.
apps.devHint: Git, Node.js, Python and the tools Claude Code and its MCP servers call. Each one is added to PATH.
apps.default.signin: Set as the default app — Windows applies it at your next sign-in.
apps.default.signinHome: Set for your next sign-in. Windows Home may ignore it — if so, use Open Settings.
apps.default.settings: Couldn't make it the default automatically — choose it in Settings.
reboot.title: Restart to finish
reboot.body: {names} need a restart to finish installing.
files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Download from the shared Google Drive folder. Nothing is run or extracted.
files.name: Name
files.noKey: Listing without an API key. Add one in Settings for faster, more reliable listings.
tweaks.title: Tweaks
tweaks.subtitle: Each tweak is one click and can be reverted.
tweaks.mouse_speed.title: Pointer speed
tweaks.mouse_speed.desc: Sets the Control Panel slider to the 5th of 11 notches.
tweaks.mouse_precision.title: Turn off Enhance pointer precision
tweaks.mouse_precision.desc: Disables mouse acceleration for consistent aim.
tweaks.power_plan.title: High performance power
tweaks.power_plan.desc: Activates the High performance plan. Display never turns off, PC never sleeps or hibernates on a timer.
tweaks.hibernate.title: Disable hibernation
tweaks.hibernate.desc: Removes hiberfil.sys and turns hibernation off entirely.
tweaks.fast_startup.title: Disable Fast Startup
tweaks.fast_startup.desc: Makes Shut down a real shutdown. Helps with dual-boot and driver updates.
tweaks.defaultsHint: Catalog apps that replace a built-in Windows app. Installing them sets this up; change or undo it here.
tweaks.types.title: {name} as the default app
tweaks.types.desc: {what} open in {name}. Windows applies it at your next sign-in, once — you can still pick another app later.
tweaks.types.desc10: {what} open in {name}. Windows 10 applies it at every sign-in until you revert it.
tweaks.types.home: Windows Home may ignore this setting. If it doesn't take after signing in, use Open Settings.
drivers.title: Drivers
drivers.subtitle: The graphics card as Windows reports it, and its latest driver. When Windows can't tell the model, the NVIDIA App finds it.
drivers.cleanHint: Resets NVIDIA settings. Recommended on a fresh Windows.
drivers.flash: Your screen may go black for a few seconds while the driver swaps.
drivers.lookupFailed: NVIDIA's driver lookup failed: {e}. The NVIDIA App will be installed instead — it finds the driver itself.
drivers.appFallback: The NVIDIA App is installed. Open it: it detects your card and offers the driver under Drivers.
drivers.amd: AMD graphics: download AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition from AMD. It is not installed silently.
drivers.intel: Intel graphics: use Intel Driver & Support Assistant. It is not installed silently.
drivers.detectFailed: Windows didn't report the graphics card ({e}). The NVIDIA App detects it and installs the right driver.
drivers.noModel: There's no NVIDIA driver yet, so Windows doesn't know the exact model. The NVIDIA App detects the card and installs the right driver.
ad.title: AD
ad.subtitle: Your launcher that patches Discord with Vencord, then opens it.
ad.cardDesc: Installs to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\AD with Desktop and Start Menu shortcuts.
ad.noDiscord: Discord isn't installed. AD needs it.
ad.done: AD is installed and open. Click Enable in its window to start it with Windows.
act.title: Activation
act.subtitle: Your Windows license status. Only your own key or digital license.
act.keyNote: The key goes straight to slmgr. It is never saved or logged.
act.msaBody: If this PC was activated before, sign in with the same Microsoft account, then open Activation settings → Troubleshoot → "I changed hardware on this device recently" to restore the digital license.
settings.title: Settings
settings.githubHint: Raises the GitHub API limit from 60 requests/hour.
settings.googleHint: Faster Drive listings with exact sizes.
settings.aboutBody: Setup Hub {v}. No telemetry. Network calls: catalog, downloads, update check (GitHub), NVIDIA lookup and Google Drive only.
settings.licenses: Built with Tauri, React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide and Inter (OFL).
my.title: My Apps
my.subtitle: Programs you added by link. They install exactly like the built-in apps.
my.emptyBody: Paste a download link, a GitHub repo, a winget ID or a Microsoft Store link.
my.removeConfirm: Remove {name} from My Apps? The program itself stays installed.
add.title: Add apps
add.placeholder: Paste a link or a winget ID
add.multiHint: One per line — several links create several entries. GitHub repos, direct files, Microsoft Store links, winget IDs and app names all work.
add.drive: This is a Google Drive link. It is downloaded, not installed.
add.driveStarted: Download started — follow it on the Files page.
add.name: Name
add.argsHint: Suggested after the first download from the detected installer type.
add.shortcut: Start Menu shortcut (exe inside the folder, optional)
review.title: Review {name}
review.body: Downloaded. Check who signed it and how it will run before the first install.
review.unsignedConfirm: Install anyway — I trust where this file comes from
review.invalid: Signature check failed ({s}). This file will not be installed.
review.archive: Archive — files inside are not signature-checked.
review.unknownType: Unknown — runs with its own window
edit.title: Edit {name}
import.title: Review apps to add
import.body: Check every link and argument before adding. Nothing is installed until you press Install.
import.none: Every app in this list is already in My Apps.
import.fromUrl: From your My Apps list URL
settings.listUrlHint: Keep the exported my_apps.json in your Google Drive (or GitHub) and paste its link here — the list comes back after a Windows reinstall.
settings.allowHttpHint: Off by default. Plain HTTP downloads can be tampered with on the way.
update.title: Setup Hub {v} is available
update.body: You have {cur}. It downloads, checks the file and restarts — about 10 seconds.
settings.checkUpdatesHint: Setup Hub itself and the apps it installed.
settings.selfCurrent: Setup Hub {v} is up to date.
